shared_elements: figure holding or grasping an object/staff
smaller subsidiary figure(s) beside a principal figure
densely filled field with little empty ground
justification: Both show low-relief human figures in profile with prominent headdresses and held objects, along with smaller accompanying figures, which is a generic ceremonial-figure scheme many traditions produce. They differ strongly in specifics: A is a tall vertical panel with a single frontal-bodied, elaborately costumed figure surrounded by dense block-like glyph signs and interlocking ornament, while B is an arched horizontal-ish scene of several slender profile figures interacting around what looks like plant or offering elements, with no comparable sign blocks or costume conventions.
